title: Choose Plan A's new visual world
question: All three directions remove the bubble-heavy geometry. Choose the world that should govern the entire app.

options.label: The Architect's Schedule
options.lineage: architectural material schedules, drawing sets and private residence specifications
options.thesis: Plan A becomes a precise spatial instrument: every day is a measured sheet, every event a placed detail.
options.viewport: A sharp two-zone plan index opens into one measured itinerary sheet, with the next journey anchored by oversized type and a single brass coordinate.
options.risk: The discipline can feel austere if the typography and empty space are not handled with warmth.

raised.raise: Extreme scale contrast makes the active plan unmistakable without adding containers.
Every day shares one fixed timeline baseline, so change is legible at a glance.
Registration-level alignment and one-pixel rules give every state a finished, signed-off quality.
State changes preserve row identity and move in place rather than blinking or remounting.

options.label: Maison Voyage
options.lineage: couture order books, private-client portfolios and fragrance packaging
options.thesis: The trip is treated like a private commission: quiet, tactile and edited down to only what deserves attention.
options.viewport: One monumental plan name sits against an almost empty field; plans and actions resolve as sharp folio tabs and ruled entries rather than cards.
options.risk: This is the most luxurious direction, but it needs ruthless restraint to avoid becoming a fashion-site costume.

options.label: Departure Ledger
options.lineage: segmented boarding passes and live international gate boards
options.thesis: Plan A becomes a living departure ledger where time orders everything and changed plans visibly settle into place.
options.viewport: A fixed-column journey board ranks plans by departure, while the active trip opens as one segmented travel document with tabular time and route data.
options.case: It wins on product clarity and interaction; the architectural direction remains stronger on quiet luxury.
options.risk: The travel connection is immediate, but the world can feel airport-utilitarian rather than private and luxurious.

options.label: Registered Annual
options.thesis: The itinerary is presented as a signed plate sequence with typographic registration furniture.
options.viewport: A continuous plate sheet gives every plan gallery-like space and precise credit rows.
options.case: Beautiful and luxurious, but less task-legible than the schedule and less specific to planning than the departure ledger.
options.kept: Its registration precision raises the chosen architectural system.
options.risk: It can turn an operating app into a portfolio that asks to be admired rather than used.

canonCard.label: Luxury travel planner
canonCard.thesis: A familiar premium itinerary app, executed with crisp cards, restrained color and excellent spacing.
canonCard.viewport: A polished dashboard leads with the next trip, followed by a clean card list and conventional bottom navigation.
canonCard.risk: Highly usable and tasteful, but still recognizably the category standard rather than a new Plan A world.
